activity.notes: Ethan Allen was not governor or formal head of the Vermont government. After returning from British captivity in 1778, he was a major military and political figure in Vermont, lobbying for admission to the United States and participating in the Haldimand negotiations until his death in 1789. ATLAS therefore records active_in rather than rules/governs.

sources.title: Freedom & Unity: Ethan Allen — Vermont Historical Society
sources.citation_text: The Vermont Historical Society describes Allen's role in events leading to Vermont's establishment, his return after captivity, lobbying for Vermont, Haldimand negotiations, and death in 1789.
